output.explanation: Seller line NIG-SA:ICV-SA-019028 (SAR 390,456, ref SA-ICINV-00595) is billed to NIG-AE, but buyer line NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031415 for the same amount and reference is booked against NorthStar Infrastructure UK Ltd (NIG-UK) instead of NIG-SA.
